situation: Someone left a note in the guest book that none of the staff remember writing.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh dear, oh dear, I'm so sorry, I should have noticed it sooner. Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Pierce, nobody's been poisoned yet, so stop apologizing to the guest book.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, put down that guest book this instant. This is a respectable establishment, and nobody writes in it without signing their name.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Sorry, Madame! I only meant to hold it properly. Oh, the note says "Room 404 remembers you," and I'm terribly sorry, but I think I just shivered.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Room 404 remembers us, Pierce? Then it has a better memory than the bar tab does.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Vex, the bar tab is none of Room 404's business. Pierce, read me that note again, slowly, and do not touch the door.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Oh, Madame, I won't touch it, I promise! Though the note does say "remembers you," which is rather worse than "remembers me," isn't it? Sorry!

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Worse for us, Pierce, because it means someone out there keeps better records than we do.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Pierce, you will stop apologizing to the hallway, and Vex, you will stop being clever at a crucial moment. Nobody is opening Room 404 tonight.
